items:
Home Highlights
- Brand New Construction
- Gulf Front Home w/ Direct Private Beach access
- Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31
- Private heated resort style pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $80 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- 6 Adult Bikes Included
- 6 seater Golf Cart included

Created by the distinguished architects at Geoff Chick & Associates and completed by the expert team at Cogent Building Group, this brand-new Gulf-front home stands as a remarkable addition to Florida’s famed 30A. Offering approximately 6,944 square feet spread across three levels, the property features eight bedrooms and nine bathrooms, each space designed to balance refined style with relaxed coastal living.
From the entryway forward, wide open living areas draw in natural light and showcase sweeping, uninterrupted views of the Gulf, giving the entire home an immediate sense of connection to the shoreline.
A series of covered outdoor spaces encourage seamless indoor - outdoor living, while the Gulf-side pool and private beach access make it effortless to enjoy the sand and water whenever you choose.
Premium materials, elevated finishes, and a floor plan suited for both entertaining and everyday comfort highlight the home’s strong attention to detail and craftsmanship.
Nestled along one of the most sought-after stretches of beach on 30A, this residence offers a coastal experience that feels both luxurious and completely at ease.
